description: Drive Ranla from the terminal with ranla-cli — sign in through the browser (no API key to paste), run Ranla's own commands (campaign, segment, page, ads, reddit, …) and handle approval cards. Use when the user wants an agent to work their Ranla account: list or draft campaigns, build segments, check approvals, or anything Ranla does in chat.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent execute the browser workflow deterministically with explicit checkpoints?
Did the agent verify final browser state with concrete evidence?
